title: Software License Usage Reporting & Cost Dashboards (Power BI)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (reporting/dashboard layer over license usage and spend data in Power BI/Excel; moderate config, pilot-to-prod).
Distinct from endpoint-reporting-dashboards (device health reporting): this product reports software LICENSE usage, cost, and renewals.
hook: Turn license data into dashboards leadership and procurement actually use
problem: License and spend data sits in exports nobody reads — so renewals surprise you, savings go unclaimed, and leadership can't see where the money goes. This solution builds a repeatable license usage and cost reporting layer in Power BI: dashboards for deployment, usage, expiration timelines, reharvesting opportunities, and cost-efficiency metrics, fed from your license and discovery data, refreshed on a schedule.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the license/spend reporting model, data sources (license inventory, usage, contracts), the KPI set (deployment, usage, expirations, cost-per-seat, savings), and the dashboard refresh cycle.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Power BI / Excel Power Query, access to license and usage data, a renewals/contract source, a reporting destination) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: define the KPI set, connect license and usage data, build the dashboards, set scheduled refresh and distribution, validate the numbers, then pilot, validate, and expand coverage.
5 PowerShell scripts — reporting-data discovery, data-reconciliation validation, a consolidated license usage and cost report, a scheduled export helper, and a reporting-scope group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A repeatable license usage and cost reporting layer in Power BI — dashboards for deployment, usage, expirations, reharvesting, and cost efficiency, fed from your license and discovery data and refreshed on a schedule. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
